name: site-spellchecker
description: Chrome extension for spell checking web pages with upsell to full site checking

scripts.dev: echo 'Extension files ready for loading in Chrome'
scripts.generate-icons: echo 'Please convert icons/icon.svg to PNG files: icon16.png, icon48.png, icon128.png'
scripts.lint: for f in content.js popup.js lib/typo.js lib/dict-worker.js tests/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test
